study_claim: Metadata-only construct validation of a materials similarity metric; no claim about property prediction or improvement transfer.
expert_judgment_policy: No expert labels, expert-created cluster names, or post-hoc expert scoring are used in model selection or evaluation.
primary_cohort: ThermoelectricMaterials project if a project-specific samples file is available; otherwise a descriptor-defined inorganic cohort frozen before evaluation.
external_replication: HTEM sample-level data, using sample-library/study identity and owner identity as weak supporting labels.
feature_sets: F3 F2 plus state/morphology; observation masks control availability only and are not scientific similarity features

algorithms: agglomerative clustering with precomputed mixed distance
HDBSCAN or density-based alternative when installed
clustering.hyperparameter_selection: Use only internal stability, coverage, silhouette/medoid separation, and noise fraction on the development partition. Do not inspect proxy labels until frozen.
clustering.cluster_count_policy: Report a stability plateau across resolutions; do not select one resolution by maximizing same-paper or institution agreement.

distance_model.mixed_distance: D(i,j) = sum_b[m_ijb * w_b * d_b(i,j)] / sum_b[m_ijb * w_b] + lambda_missing * M(i,j)
distance_model.initial_block_weights: Equal block weights; sensitivity grid selected only by resampling stability, never by proxy agreement.
composition_candidates: element-set Jaccard as a deliberately simple baseline
distance_model.process_distance: Controlled-vocabulary Jaccard for unordered metadata; edit/sequence distance only where ordered operations are present.
distance_model.missing_block_rule: Pairwise available-block renormalization; lambda_missing = 0 in the primary analysis and a small penalty is sensitivity-only.

primary.label: same SID; normalized DOI grouping is sensitivity-only
primary.restriction: not used in features or hyperparameter tuning

secondary.label: same institution on different papers
secondary.restriction: requires DOI enrichment; exclude same-paper pairs; normalize institutions to stable IDs; exclude or down-weight very large institutions

tertiary.label: same held-out MaterialFamily
tertiary.role: exploratory database-taxonomy sensitivity only; excluded from confirmatory conclusions
tertiary.restriction: MaterialFamily must be removed from features and cannot determine GO/NO-GO because its curation may embed human judgment

evaluation.split_policy: Freeze a development/test partition by SID before feature engineering. Proxy labels are hidden during distance and clustering selection; final metrics are computed once on test papers.
primary_metrics: same-paper cluster co-assignment lift versus composition-matched unlabeled pairs
within-cluster same-paper odds ratio versus stratified permutation null
incremental co-assignment lift of F2/F3 over F0 under paper-block bootstrap
secondary_metrics: known-positive retrieval average precision against a composition-matched unlabeled pool, reported as a descriptive PU metric
exploratory held-out MaterialFamily adjusted mutual information, not used for decisions
evaluation.uncertainty: paper-block bootstrap with 95% percentile intervals and at least 1000 stratified label permutations
candidate_pair_matching: overlapping element set or equal coarse composition family
evaluation.positive_unlabeled_rule: Same-paper and same-institution pairs are known positives only. Pairs without a shared context are unlabeled and must never be called negatives.
evaluation.random_pair_sampling: For each known-positive pair, sample unlabeled comparators within the prespecified composition/domain strata; repeat at least 20 times.
evaluation.multiple_testing: Report all frozen feature-set and distance variants; control false discovery rate for secondary comparisons and emphasize effect sizes with intervals.

negative_controls: shuffle process fields across samples within composition strata
source_leakage_checks: Predict SID/institution from missingness masks and descriptor-key presence alone
Repeat evaluation with missingness penalty fixed to zero
Repeat same-paper evaluation using only cross-figure or non-identical-composition pairs when available
Run institution analysis only across different papers and report institution-size sensitivity
proxy_falsification_checks: Estimate same-paper lift after exact-composition pairs are removed
Estimate same-paper lift after restricting to pairs from different figures when figure identity is available
Estimate institution lift only for different papers, different first authors, and multiple institution-size cutoffs
Compare observed lift with source-metadata-only and missingness-only baselines
Treat a proxy disagreement as ambiguity, never as evidence that the materials are dissimilar

data_integrity: duplicate (SID, sample_id) rows are zero after quarantine
all property/curve fields are absent from the modeling table
minimum_scale: at least 1000 SID groups with two or more usable samples
at least 30 percent of usable samples have a nonempty fabrication/form/state descriptor
phase1_success: F2 or F3 improves same-paper cluster co-assignment lift over F0 with a paper-block 95% interval excluding zero
improvement remains after composition-matched permutation and missingness-zero sensitivity
bootstrap co-assignment stability median at least 0.70
no single paper or institution accounts for more than 10 percent of the observed lift
go_no_go.interpretation_if_failed: Reject or revise the metadata similarity representation, not the existence of scientifically meaningful material similarity.
